summary: One SQLite FTS5 lexical index meets both per-lane thresholds for ten of the eleven declared lanes. The benchmark therefore cannot distinguish eleven retrieval capabilities from one, and its per-lane scores do not establish per-lane capability.

method.expression_rule: first six alphabetic query terms joined by OR, FTS5 operators excluded
method.metrics: Recall@20 and nDCG@20 over the same labels and thresholds the benchmark asserts

provenance.expression_rule_sensitivity: the finding is not an artifact of the six-term rule; using every alphabetic term with OR, and with AND, also yields 11/11 at 1.00/1.00

gate_result_on_substituted_ranking.interpretation: the acceptance oracle itself, not merely the raw scores, admits a single-channel run as an eleven-lane pass

root_cause.observation: the gate receives document rankings only. It has no candidate provenance, no retrieval channel, no backend or adapter identity, and therefore no information with which to reject a lane whose result came from a different channel than the lane names.
root_cause.consequence: no fixture, however discriminating, can make this gate reject channel substitution while its inputs remain provenance-free

secondary_finding.observation: evaluate_retrieval_benchmark writes live_network_calls: 0 and live_llm_calls: 0 as literals into the report it returns, and assert_benchmark_thresholds then reads those same literals to decide whether the run was local and deterministic. Neither value is an argument, a measurement, or an observation of the run.
secondary_finding.consequence: BENCHMARK_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY can never fire. A benchmark that made live network or model calls would report zero of each and pass this check, so the recorded local-and-deterministic property is asserted rather than demonstrated.
secondary_finding.not_claimed: no evidence that the current O02 benchmark actually makes network or model calls; the point is that this check could not detect it if one did

pattern_scope.note: see also required_check_callsite_drift below, found while attempting the two audits Pro named for the sibling checks
pattern_scope.question: whether this vacuous-check shape occurs elsewhere in the production trees
pattern_scope.method: AST census over src/** and python/**, excluding tests: functions that write a literal into a returned dict, for a key the caller cannot supply and the function never otherwise touches, where a sibling function reads that key to raise
pattern_scope.result: exactly one match, the O02 benchmark pair recorded above
pattern_scope.false_positives_excluded: python/epistemic_foundry/storage/postgres/store.py produced eight apparent matches; each was inspected and rejected, because those reporters query the database and raise on a bad observation before returning, so their ok and code fields are earned rather than asserted

second_census.question: whether any canonical schema field that asserts a property is only ever written as a constant
second_census.method: collect schema properties whose names assert verification, counting, independence, leakage, determinism, reproducibility, attestation, or audit; compare literal against computed writes across src/** and python/**
second_census.interpretation: the asserted-rather-than-observed shape is not widespread in the Python trees. The benchmark's live-call counters are the exception found, not an instance of a general habit.

third_census.question: whether the same shape occurs in the JavaScript packages
third_census.method: text triage over packages/** excluding tests, generated code, and dist: object fields named for verification, counting, independence, leakage, determinism, or reproducibility that are written as 0, false, true, or [] and never assigned a computed value anywhere in the same file
third_census.caveat: text triage rather than AST parsing; suitable for finding candidates to read by hand, not authoritative on absence

pattern_scope.not_covered: none of the three censuses detects a field that is computed but only from an input the caller controls, nor one whose observation is real but wrong

contributing_fixture_properties.overlap_definition: share of query terms longer than two characters that also occur in the query's one labelled relevant document
contributing_fixture_properties.distinctive_terms_note: each query carries terms occurring in exactly one corpus document, so the query contains a unique key to its own answer
contributing_fixture_properties.structural_note: with a corpus smaller than the cutoff and one relevant document per query, Recall@20 reaches 1.0 for any backend returning the whole corpus; the nDCG@20 threshold of 0.85 reduces to requiring rank 1

not_claimed: that the eight unserved lanes were implemented

that any persisted or evidentiary receipt was synthesised; the lexical executions seal ordinary transient EXECUTION receipts for the lexical lane only, and none is stored or offered as evidence for an unserved lane
